title: Prescribed-qbot capacity-controlled retention support
diagnosis: F-AHL12D showed that prescribed-qbot Newton-path sensitivity tracks local C/Jacobian error more directly than the global theta error target. The original 28-point support had local |dlogC| of order 1e-6 to 5e-6 and required one extra iteration; theta-only refinement accidentally worsened local C error to order 1e-5 to 5e-5.
question: Can a timestep-independent derivative-consistent retention interpolant controlled directly by relative/log capacity error recover the analytical prescribed-qbot Newton path?
frozen_case: B01:wet, bottom_mode=2, qbot=1e-6 cm/day, dt=0.01 day
representation: cubic Hermite z=logit(Se), C derived from the same interpolant derivative; conductivity support remains independently fixed at F-AHL11 k03
decision_rule: Select the loosest prospectively tested C limit that restores analytical iteration and backtracking counts while passing frozen state and mass gates. If neither passes, stop density tuning and change representation family or solver-facing error metric.
